responsibility: This implementation module provides a primitive token scanner for text files or standard input. It tracks the current source line, cursor position, current symbol length, and optional comment syntax; skips whitespace and configured comments; treats quoted strings specially across successive calls; reads characters through FIO or StdIO; and emits caret-underlined diagnostics with filename and line number via WriteError, optionally terminating through libc exit. Its responsibility is lightweight symbol extraction and source-positioned error reporting rather than full parsing.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Scan pair: it carries the scanner state and code for reading from FIO or StdIO, skipping whitespace/comments, handling quoted strings, tracking line and cursor positions, and formatting diagnostics for the API declared in Scan.def.
